name: B10-0186/2025 (ESN) – Severe political, humanitarian and human rights crisis in Sudan, in particular the sexual violence and child rape
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the severe political, humanitarian and human rights crisis in Sudan, in particular the sexual violence and child rape
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its position on the war in Sudan. It condemns violence against civilians by both sides in the conflict, and especially the widespread sexual violence, including against young children. It calls for Sudanese refugees to be housed in the region rather than coming to Europe, and it criticises sanctions as ineffective. It also notes that weapons are being imported into Sudan from several countries.

- The text only states opinions and asks for nothing binding.
- It concerns civilians in Sudan, refugees, and weapons-supplying countries.
- It will be sent to the Council, the Commission and other bodies.
